**Saturday August 23rd Capturing suggestions surfacing within the “Citizen Tech” phenomena from the night before at the shelter and later at the “Battle for the Intersection” where an additional 5-7+ innocent drivers were added to the “euthanization list”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** As part of my daily process, I capture thoughts on the night before at the shelter during my morning walk downtown. Later, upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. Over a couple hours hundreds of vehicles in this busy thoroughfare are subjected to the unconsented to statement “Do not support this person!” repeatedly and the drivers that engage in the conversation are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.

**Sunday August 24th Capturing suggestions surfacing within the “Citizen Tech” phenomena from the night before at the shelter and later more innocent drivers are added to the ever growing “euthanization list”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

This entry also includes some manually captured transcripts using my Android mobile phone’s keypad while listening.

**Scene:** As part of my daily process, I capture thoughts on the night before at the shelter during my morning walk downtown. Later, upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. Over a couple hours hundreds of vehicles in this busy thoroughfare are subjected to the unconsented to statement “Do not support this person!” repeatedly and the drivers that engage in the conversation are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.

##### **Manual Capture**

**9:30am, Capturing some thoughts manually using my phone’s keypad after leaving the 48th St. shelter.*

“Where is this person? I hate this assignment. He has to accept euthanization.” **Male #1, frustrated* 

(paraphrasing) “Stay away from that person.” **Female #1?*

“You look like monsters to normal people.” **Male#2?*

“Yes we do look like monsters to normal people.” **Female #2?, calm*

“We can not use this system to euthanize people any longer.” **Female #2, discouraged* 

“Don't say that! We are on a mission from Jesus Christ.” **Male #?, confident and concerned* 

“Let's just put this person in witness protection.” **Male #3?*

“Now they're just diffusing the conversation. Diffusing the conversation is what I said.” **Male #2?*

“Do not send that to yourself! Do not send that to yourself!” **Female #?, angry*

**Monday August 25th Capturing life threatening “Citizen Tech” suggestions from the night before and later Denver’s citizens continue to be added to a covert euthanization list at the “Battle for the Intersection”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

This entry also includes some manually captured transcripts using my Android mobile phone’s keypad while listening.

**Scene:** As part of my daily process, I capture thoughts on the night before at the shelter during my morning walk downtown. Later, upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. Over a couple hours hundreds of vehicles in this busy thoroughfare are subjected to the unconsented to statement “Do not support this person!” repeatedly and the drivers that engage in the conversation are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.

**Tuesday August 26th Capturing life threatening “Citizen Tech” suggestions from the night before. Later at the “Battle for the Intersection” another terrorist threat is made, “America will be bombed very soon” while Denver’s citizens continue to be added to a covert euthanization list.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

This entry also includes some manually captured transcripts using my Android mobile phone’s keypad while listening.

**Scene:** As part of my daily process, I capture thoughts on the night before at the shelter during my morning walk downtown. Later, upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. Over a couple hours hundreds of vehicles in this busy thoroughfare are subjected to the unconsented to statement “Do not support this person!” repeatedly and the drivers that engage in the conversation are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.

**Saturday August 30th recapping life threatening “Citizen Tech” patterns of suggestion from the night before. Later at the “Battle for the Intersection” more of Denver’s citizens are added to a covert euthanization list.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** As part of my daily process, I capture thoughts on the night before at the shelter during my morning walk downtown. Later, upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process and the so-called “ugly workflows” on myself and the community. Over a couple hours hundreds of vehicles in this busy thoroughfare are subjected to the unconsented to statement “Do not support this person!” repeatedly and the drivers that engage in the conversation are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.

**Sunday August 31st Review themes from life threatening “Citizen Tech” suggestions from the night before. Later at the “Battle for the Intersection” more of Denver’s citizens are added to a covert euthanization list.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** As part of my daily process, I capture thoughts on the night before at the shelter during my morning walk downtown. Later, upon arrival at the intersection, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process and the so-called “ugly workflows” on myself and the community. Over a couple hours hundreds of vehicles in this busy thoroughfare are subjected to the unconsented to statement “Do not support this person!” repeatedly and the drivers that engage in the conversation are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.

**Wednesday September 10th capturing another so-called “Battle for the Intersection" and sharing some thoughts on the negative psychological and emotional impact from being exposed to weaponization of our bodies and sexuality.** 

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the vehicles are tormented with the statement “Do not support this person!”.

**Thursday September 11th Capturing transcripts from another so called “Battle for the Intersection where innocent drivers are added to the “euthanization list”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the passengers in the passing vehicles are added to the “euthanization list” after being tormented with the statement “Do not support this person, to the left of you!”.

**Friday September 12th, capturing transcripts at another “Battle for the Intersection” where innocent citizens continue to be added to the “euthanization list”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** I record thoughts from the night before on the way into downtown Denver, CO.. Later, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the passengers in the passing vehicles are added to the “euthanization list” after being tormented with the statement “Do not support this person, to the left of you!”.

**Saturday September 13th, Capturing another “Battle for the Intersection” and takeaways after.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the passengers in the passing vehicles are added to the “euthanization list” after being tormented with the statement “Do not support this person, to the left of you!”.

**Sunday September 14th Capturing transcripts for a very busy day beginning with takeaways from the night at the shelter, afternoon feedback and another so-called “Battle for the Intersection" where innocent drivers are added to the “euthanization list”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** In the morning I record thoughts from the night before on the way into downtown Denver, CO.. Later, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the passengers in the passing vehicles are added to the “euthanization list” after being tormented with the statement “Do not support this person, to the left of you!”.

**Monday September 15th, Capturing transcripts for a very busy day beginning with a few questions from a group within the “Citizen Tech” conversation and a firm warning from the state of Colorado. Later, additional citizens continue to be added to the “euthanization list” in the “Battle for the Intersection”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** In the morning I record thoughts from the night before on the way into downtown Denver, CO.. Later, I stand with my cardboard sign, recording the impact of the breaching process on myself and the community. It’s a very common suggestion that the passengers in the passing vehicles are added to the “euthanization list” after being tormented with the statement “Do not support this person, to the left of you!”.

##### **Notes from 12:00pm-1:00pm** ***In-progress**

While walking to the Tattered Cover Bookstore to enter transcripts I find myself in the middle of another “Citizen Tech” conversation involving at least two groups of people. One group claims to be the Chinese government with their voices including accents emanating from somewhere far in the distance and the other group sounds like adult caucasians, with their voices emanating from a position much closer. In general there is a sense of surprise and deep concern from the caucasian voices for the suggestion of the Chinese government communicating with Denver, CO..

Additional notes:

  - One of the so-called Chinese voices suggested that they hoped making contact with us telepathically would have been a more positive experience but due to the size of the threat of euthanization in Denver, CO. the situation was “life threatening”. 
  - The caucasian voices did not identify with any organization. However, suggestions were made i.e. (paraphrasing) “Homeland Security is not doing well with this information today.” 
  - Many attempts at identifying the so-called Chinese voices were made (paraphrasing) “Who is talking to this person? (myself, Sean C. Harris)”, (paraphrasing) “Who is speaking with us?”
  - The so-called Chinese government voices suggested that had I not connected to the caucasians in the past, today’s conversation would not be possible. Is this suggestion and the conversation in general, evidence of the local facilitators of euthanization i.e. caucasians, finally acknowledging unknown communicators i.e. Chinese government?
  - The caucasian voices asked the so-called chinese government if they were funding euthanization in America (paraphrasing) “Have you been funding euthanization in America?” and the response was (paraphrasing) “Yes, America.”
  - However, voices claiming to be the Chinese government asked the caucasians why they were euthanizing their citizens.
  - …

Questions & Comments:

  - I did not inspect the so-called Chinese voices for the use of voice filters or the presence of an underlying voice. Unfortunately, the modification of voices is very common and there is also an assumption where A.I. Artificial Intelligence would need to build a telepathic voice from brain activity, possibly inviting an unintended disguise.
  - In the past telepathic visual information has suggested the presence of asian and middle eastern facilitators using ethnic disguises. For example, asian people disguising themselves with masks or as middle eastern people and middle eastern people disguising themselves as asian people.
  - All of that said, who are these people? Remember all “Citizen Tech” claims should be substantiated i.e. legally binding testimony, official statements, technology demonstrations, etc.
  - How much of the above experience communicating was negatively impacted by manipulation?
  - How does the threat of euthanization complicate the relationship between all groups and individuals communicating? Over time both sides have identified with the facilitation of euthanization.
  - What are the differences in motivation for euthanizing America’s citizens? i.e. caucasians vs. so-called Chinese government.
  - How many “Citizen Tech” systems are there? I.e. (paraphrasing) “We are aware of one D.E.A. (Drug Enforcement Administration) system and another C.I.A. (Central Intelligence Agency) system that Homeland Security uses but we were not aware of a Chinese government system.” *In-progress

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder.   - Possible law enforcement challenges related to the unconsented to conversation emerging within the “Citizen Tech” method of communication.
  - Attempts to use friends to harm me. This is a very large pattern of “Citizen Tech” communication.

##### **Old friend is asked to harm me**  

I bumped into some old friends. As I type this a “Citizen Tech” suggestion happens “This is so important! Thank you for adding this to the summary.”

These old friends like many other people I have spent time around most notably my guest stay with room mates at the Cirrus Apartments were terrorized using “Citizen Tech” communication aggressively. The suggestion was that they were going to be used to harm me and because I avoided them in hopes of saving their lives, they were verbally punished and threatened with immediate incarceration by law enforcement. There was a debate on what type of law enforcement was suggested, DEA or DPD (Denver Police Department). During this brief interaction there was also the suggestion of another group of “Citizen Tech” contributors that was protective of the three of us and advising us on how to move away from the life threatening conversation (paraphrasing) “You two should move indoors immediately.”  

##### **Battle for the intersection**

I did confirm the threat to the city of Denver was still present at another “Battle for the Intersection” on this day. I was only there for approximately 10m before receiving one donation for $20 from a middle eastern person driving by. I left immediately after to prevent the spread of euthanization.

Intersection takeaways:

  - My sign read “Free Palestine, anything helps.
  - There may have been “Citizen Tech” suggestions related to my sign that may have indicated Israeli or Palestinian presence in the conversation (paraphrasing) “I don’t know how I feel about that sign, he’s supporting us.” also (paraphrasing) “Microsoft isn't sure how they feel about that sign.”
  - I mentioned that I was not going to repeat anything that day which may have invited hesitation on behalf of the facilitators to spread euthanization to the intersection. “Do not support this person” was suggested a few times immediately after I started repeating to make sure I surfaced the threat if I was there.

**Thursday September 25th capturing some afternoon thoughts on the night before at the 48th St. DRM (Denver Rescue Mission) shelter and later at the intersection another terrorist claim involving a Microsoft location in Israel.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)

**Scene:** I’m traveling around downtown Denver, CO. completing errands by scooter and on foot. Later at the intersection, I hold a cardboard sign in hopes of receiving donations and revealing the threat to the community.

**Friday September 26th reviewing additional life threatening themes and POV (Point of View) visual information from the night before at the 48th St. DRM (Denver Rescue Mission) shelter. Later at the so-called “Battle for the Intersection” more of Denver’s innocent citizens are suggested to be added to the “euthanization list”.**

**Methodology:** I capture manual transcripts of the telepathic and or audible “Citizen Tech” phenomena by repeating the suggestions I receive out loud while recording using the native Android voice recorder. Transcriptions of the .mp3 recordings are generated with Google AI Studio. [**See sample screen recording*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16PkRWIlH4c6SZxpFRagmVGgMt12eE8tG/view?usp=sharing)
